request.prompt: Create an original a friendly small quadruped dragon with ember-red scales, warm cream belly, stubby rear horns, a chunky tapering tail and two small leathery wings folded by its back. Cute and recognisably a dragon, grounded rather than flying. Compact vanilla Minecraft companion, feet y=0, centre x=z=8, face negative Z, height about 10-14 units, 16 units per block. Under 26 purposeful cubes and 14 bones. Main torso bone named body and main head bone named head, with broad cuboids. Leg bone names contain front or rear (phoenix legs use rear). Ear elements contain ear, horns contain horn and crest pieces contain crest. Head top front half must be flat and clear to fit small hats: ears, horns and crest go on the rear half, leaving a broad clear forehead ledge. Exactly TWO symmetrically placed eyes, spaced evenly from outer edges; no duplicate side eyes or eyes on back. Integer cube-net UV sizes, explicit integer uvSize for fractional geometry. One pixel atlas, subtle restrained vanilla pixel shading. Every element belongs to the connected rig. No accessories, props or detached effects. No intersecting coplanar faces or z-fighting. Anatomical overlaps only at true joints.
request.name: Orange Pets dragon ember
request.animationBrief: Exactly six clips named idle, walk, sleep, happy, eat, sit. Loop idle and walk. Small wing stretch when happy, gentle head bob, tail swish; curl comfortably at rest. Head nod for eat. Keep all feet above ground and physical clearances between body, wings, legs, horns and head through every pose. No attack, flight or swim clips.
